department: Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering, FAMU-FSU College of Engineering

deadline.value: International applicants outside the U.S. are highly encouraged to apply by January 15, 2027 for Fall; department financial assistance/TA priority deadline is March 1, 2027, and final Fall PhD deadline is May 1, 2027 (Spring: November 1, Summer: March 1).
deadline.quote: International applicants living outside of the United States are highly encouraged to apply by January 15 for the fall semester. | Fall | 1 May

also.quote: To be considered for department financial assistance such as Teaching Assistantships, the last date for receiving a complete application is March 1 for the Fall term.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Electrical Engineering; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Graduate Coordinator serves by default as the initial adviser for all incoming ECE graduate students, and students are encouraged to select a faculty adviser upon arrival via the Adviser Form.
supervisor.quote: The Graduate Coordinator is by default the initial adviser of all incoming graduate students, however, students are strongly encouraged to select another adviser among the current faculties as soon as they arrive in the ECE Department by filling in the Adviser Form.

funding.value: FAMU-FSU Engineering PhD programs offer competitive funding packages (RAs, TAs, tuition waivers, health care, stipends) renewable up to four years based on progress and availability; international TA applicants need TOEFL Speaking >= 26 or FSU SPEAK >= 45.
funding.quote: The FAMU-FSU College of Engineering Ph.D. programs offer competitive funding packages for newly admitted students.

also.quote: Students who are not native speakers of English should take the speaking section of the TOEFL test (and have a score of 26 points or higher) or the SPEAK test at FSU (and have a score of 45 points or higher) in order to be eligible to apply to for a teaching assistantship.

entry_route.value: Candidates may enter with a B.S. or M.S. degree in electrical engineering or a closely related discipline across five coursework tracks (BS-to-PhD and multiple MS-to-PhD tracks).
entry_route.quote: candidates must have earned a bachelor of science or a master degree (or equivalent) in electrical engineering, or in a closely related discipline | BS-to-PhD: if the student has a BS degree in EE or related areas. | MS/EE-to-PhD: if the student has a MS degree in electrical engineering or equivalent.

fee_waiver.value: Starting Fall 2027, the FAMU-FSU College of Engineering ADRGS office offers a limited number of application fee waivers exclusively for PhD applicants on a first-come, first-served basis (for FAMU applicants, complete the ApplyWeb application up to the Acknowledgement section without paying and submit the waiver request form).
fee_waiver.quote: offering a limited number of application fee waivers for PhD applicants, starting in the Fall 2027 semester. Only PhD applicants are eligible to request an application fee waiver at this time. Application fee waivers will be awarded on a first come, first serve basis.

also.quote: Starting for the Fall 2027 semester PhD applicants can apply for the application fee to be waived.

toefl_min.value: Department admissions pages state a minimum new iBT TOEFL score of 4.0 (550 paper-based); note the central College of Engineering admissions page still lists legacy 80 iBT.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the FAMU-FSU College of Engineering exempt-country list, and departments require English proficiency scores unless the applicant's country's official language is English or they graduated from an accredited U.S. bachelor's or master's program.
english_waiver.quote: The English Language Proficiency requirement can be waived, at the University-level, for applicants who have earned a minimum of a bachelor’s degree or higher in the US or in an English-Speaking Country.

also.quote: For International students, an English Proficiency Score Report is required if: | The applicant’s country’s official language is NOT English or | The applicant did NOT graduate from an accredited US institution with either a bachelor’s or master’s degree.

gre_general.value: GRE General is required (minimum 151 quantitative and 145 verbal), though qualified PhD applicants may apply for a GRE waiver using the College's GRE waiver request form.
gre_general.quote: A minimum score of 151 points for the quantitative section and 145 points for the verbal section of the GRE test; GRE waiver request form.

also.quote: highly qualified doctoral applicants may be eligible to waive the GRE.

notes: Joint FAMU-FSU College of Engineering program; apply through either FAMU or FSU, not both. PhD catalog page notes 3.3+ GPA alongside 3.0+ on admissions requirements page.
